mechanism_claims.claim_text: ID13 directly perturbs the bacterial membrane as supported by PI uptake and potassium leakage assays.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is supported for S. aureus CVCC 546 under the reported assay conditions; it is not generalized to all bacteria.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: ID13 interacts with genomic DNA and changes DNA conformation in gel-retardation, AFM, and CD assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ID13 and S. aureus CVCC 546 genomic DNA
mechanism_claims.limitations: The DNA interaction is shown in vitro; the paper does not prove DNA binding is the sole lethal mechanism in vivo.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: SEM/TEM morphology supports cell-envelope damage after ID13 exposure.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Microscopy is morphological evidence and is interpreted together with PI and K+ leakage assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Time-kill, PAE, and mouse thigh infection data support antibacterial efficacy but are pharmacodynamic outcomes rather than standalone molecular mechanism claims.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: ID13 in S. aureus CVCC 546 pharmacodynamic assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: Recorded as efficacy context; not promoted to direct mechanism evidence.
